text:
rachel: kicking off overnight toggle for feature `llmroute_v3_fastpath`. change window 00:30-02:30 UTC. plan: canary 0.5% eu-west -> 5% after 20m -> 25% after 40m -> full 100% by 02:00 if all holdpoints pass. model pinned to model-route v3.1.0. quiet window: no other routing/model rolls in this window. @deploybot please schedule, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack scheduled. steps: 00:30 canary 0.5%, hold 20m, 00:50 ramp 5%, hold 40m, 01:30 ramp 25%, hold 30m, 02:00 finalize 100%. will post metrics and step confirmations.

mark: proposing rollback gates: sustained p95 > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.4% (5m) OR token-queue-length > 2.5x baseline. add semantic drift gate: A/B eval delta > 2.5% on curated prompts => rollback.

dan: add operational fail-safe: if any dependent service DB connections spike > 30% 5m, we soft-drain new cohorts and pause ramp. also ensure we have fast pin to v2.3.7. runbook: https://go/runbooks/llmroute-fastpin.

deploybot: rollback action set: pin traffic back to model-route v2.3.7 and set `llmroute_v3_fastpath=off` for all cohorts. ops rollback command:
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_fastpath --pin-version v2.3.7 --note "auto-rollback: telemetry"
```

sre-oncall: standing by. i'll mute non-actionable alerts and watch p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue-length, and DB conn spikes. if gate trips will either let deploybot auto-rollback or execute manual pin if needed.

rachel: please make the customer-facing blurb minimal: "routing experiment in eu-west 00:30-02:30 UTC, automatic fallback available" and include SRE contact.

deploybot: canary 0.5% executed at 00:30 UTC. metrics snapshot due ~00:38.

mark: if canary green at 00:50, proceed 5% at 00:55 and schedule manual quick-eval at 01:20 before 25% ramp.

deploybot: metrics snapshot (00:38): p95=290ms, error-rate=0.08%, cpu=46%, token-queue-length=1.1x. prelim pass. holding until 00:50 holdpoint.

sre-oncall: looks clean so far. i'll keep watch and call rollback if anything crosses gates.

dan: reminder: on rollback we must also revoke any canary-specific cache warming hooks and clear local prefix cache to avoid stale responses. runbook note updated.

rachel: thanks all. i'll update the release note once we hit 5% stable.
